scenes.say: You asked, we're making it harder! How big a Formula One fan are you? Medium level!
Question one. When was the first world championship? Nineteen forty-six, fifty, or fifty-eight?
Nineteen fifty! Giuseppe Farina won the first race and became the first champion.
Question two. Who has the most Grand Prix wins? Hamilton, Schumacher, or Verstappen?
Lewis Hamilton, with more than a hundred! Schumacher has ninety-one.
Question three. Which track is called the Temple of Speed? Monaco, Silverstone, or Monza?
Monza! Long straights and flat out for almost the whole lap. That's the track you're looking at.
Question four. Which team has the most Constructors' titles? McLaren, Ferrari, or Mercedes?
Ferrari, with sixteen! McLaren has ten, Mercedes nine.
Now a trick question! What's gone from the Formula One power unit since twenty twenty-six? The turbo, the MGU-H, or the MGU-K?
The MGU-H! The turbo stayed, and the MGU-K got almost three times more powerful.
Last one. Who is the youngest world champion in history? Vettel, Verstappen, or Antonelli?
Kimi Antonelli! He won the title this year at twenty, beating Vettel's record.
Six out of six: you're a real expert! Four or five: a solid fan. Fewer: try the easy level first.
Drop your score in the comments, and follow the races on the LapRadar live map.

title: How big an F1 fan are you? Medium level
caption: You asked, we're making it harder! How big an F1 fan are you? 6 questions, medium level, 3 seconds each. Drop your score in the comments! Live race map: lapradar.com
